ValidationRule.description: Mega-rule: ETA/delivery timestamps (DATETIMEVALUE, ISOWEEK, FORMATDURATION), dock-window time checks, post-ship lock via ISCHANGED/PRIORVALUE, and a VLOOKUP into the project's risk score that demands Signature Required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Shipped_At__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Estimated_Arrival__c)), OR( Estimated_Arrival__c <= Shipped_At__c, Estimated_Arrival__c > Shipped_At__c + 60, AND(ISOWEEK(DATEVALUE(Shipped_At__c)) = 53, NOT(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Signature Required'))) ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Delivered'), OR(ISBLANK(Delivered_At__c), Delivered_At__c < NULLVALUE(Shipped_At__c, Delivered_At__c)) ), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Delivered_At__c)), DATEVALUE(Delivered_At__c) > TODAY() + 1), AND(NULLVALUE(Transit_Seconds__c, 0) > 0, LEN(FORMATDURATION(Transit_Seconds__c)) = 0), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Dock_Time__c)), OR( HOUR(Dock_Time__c) < 7, HOUR(Dock_Time__c) > 18, AND(HOUR(Dock_Time__c) = 12, MINUTE(Dock_Time__c) = 30), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Estimated_Arrival__c)), TIMEVALUE(Estimated_Arrival__c) = TIMEVALUE('00:00:00.000'), SECOND(Dock_Time__c) + MILLISECOND(Dock_Time__c) > 0 ) ) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Delivered'), ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Returned'))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Shipped_At__c))), OR(ISCHANGED(Tracking_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Carrier__c))) ) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Project_Name_Ref__c)), NULLVALUE(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Risk_Score__c, $ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Name, Project_Name_Ref__c), 0) > 7, OR( NOT(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Signature Required')), AND(Is_International__c, OR(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Ground'), NULLVALUE(Declared_Value__c, 0) > 5000)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shipment timeline, lock or project-risk handling rules failed.
